key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh usage data, in seconds

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP proxy URL, for example http://localhost:11809. Empty means no proxy.

key.name: prefs-page
key.description: Set by a menu's Settings button so the settings window opens on that service's tab

key.name: display-mode
key.description: 'rings' double ring and percentage. The outer ring is the first limit (5-hour, or Cursor Models) and the inner ring is the second (weekly, or Other Models). 'rings-only' is the double ring alone, 'ring' a single ring and percentage, 'text' percentage, 'bar' a progress bar, 'both' bar and percentage

key.name: panel-window
key.description: 'Choose which limit to display in the top bar: 'primary' the first limit, 'secondary' the second limit, 'max' whichever is closer to running out

key.name: usage-display
key.description: Show used or remaining percentages in the top bar

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Show the service icon in the top bar in color or monochrome

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Show the service icon in the top bar

key.name: show-tier
key.description: Show the plan name in the top bar

key.name: show-additional-limits
key.description: Show per-model limits in the popover menu

key.name: folder
key.description: Path to the folder holding the service's sign-in. If empty, it automatically searches the usual places (~/.claude, ~/.codex or ~/.config/Cursor).

key.name: paused-until
key.description: Time to wait before service attempts to check again, in Unix time.

key.name: last-usage
key.description: Cached usage data from the last available check, in case of API errors.
